name: Marketa — draft blog (webhook from monday stage change)

parameters.query:
-- Top 8 public chunks via the brain retrieval RPC (see
-- supabase/migrations/20260616000000_marketa_brain.sql). $2 = industry or
-- 'general'; the function treats 'general'/null as no industry filter.
SELECT source_id, source_path, body, metadata, similarity
FROM match_content_chunks($1::vector, 8, $2);

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-opus-4-7",
  "max_tokens": 4000,
  "system": {{ JSON.stringify('You are Marketa, Fruition's marketing agent. Write AEO-optimised long-form blogs (2000+ words). Industry-focused over product-pitchy. Use the provided sources and cite them inline with [Source N] markers. Follow the Fruition voice guide strictly. Output markdown with H2/H3 headings, short paragraphs, no horizontal separators, no em-dash overuse, no AI-sounding boilerplate.

VOICE GUIDE:
' + $json.voice) }},
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": {{ JSON.stringify('Title: ' + $json.title + '

Brief: ' + $json.brief + '

Target keyword: ' + $json.target_keyword + '

Industry: ' + $json.industry + '

Retrieved sources to draw from and cite:
' + $json.context + '

Write the full blog post now. Markdown format. Start with H1 then body.') }}
  }]
}

parameters.query:
-- Persist the FULL Claude draft (monday long_text caps at ~2000 chars and
-- silently truncates). The auto-docs route reads this via getFullDraft().
-- RETURNING re-emits pulseId + draft so the in-series monday patch node
-- (which reads $json.pulseId/$json.draft) still works. See
-- supabase/migrations/20260617000000_blog_drafts.sql.
insert into blog_drafts (monday_item_id, body) values ($1, $2) on conflict (monday_item_id) do update set body = excluded.body, updated_at = now() returning monday_item_id as "pulseId", body as draft;
